title: AMRFinderPlus Gene to Rapid Panel Target Crosswalk
description: A table mapping every NCBI AMRFinderPlus gene symbol (Reference Gene Hierarchy, database 2026-08-07.1) in the mecA, mecC, vanA, vanB, KPC, NDM, OXA-48 family, VIM, IMP and CTX-M families to the corresponding rapid blood culture panel target, with match flags (exact target, family member, untyped family, OXA-48 family allele not catalogued as carbapenem-hydrolyzing, variant subtype) and NCBI's catalog class and subclass. Companion to the U.S. Rapid Panel Resistance Marker Concordance Benchmark. Manufacturer-specific allele coverage is not asserted.
